name: c4-architecture
description: Create and maintain C4 architecture models as Structurizr DSL workspaces rendered to SVG.

interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex skill for creating C4 architecture models with Structurizr DSL as the source of truth and SVG rendering through a Makefile pipeline. It emphasizes evidence, security-relevant boundaries, and avoiding invented architecture.
defaultPrompt: Use c4-architecture to create C4 docs for this repo.
Use c4-architecture to update docs/c4 after this architecture change.
Use c4-architecture to review whether our C4 model matches the code.
